step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents SK Telecom's Next-Generation Cloud Management Platform, divided into two sections: CAP (Cloud Admin Portal) and CBP (Cloud Biz Platform). For CAP, external web users access the Cloud Admin Portal via CloudFront, which forwards traffic to an ELB. The ELB balances requests across Fargate microservices, ElastiCache (Redis) for session and auth storage, and RDS Aurora as the core relational database. For CBP, external BSS/OSS data sources and on-premises infrastructure via Direct Connect feed telemetry into S3 for storage and SageMaker for AI analytics (using built-in PCA, RCF, and custom algorithms).

graph.name: SK Telecom Next-Generation Cloud Management Platform
